entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: Information element indicating PDU sessions associated with non-3GPP access for which user-plane resources are allowed to be re-established over 3GPP access.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to request establishment of services.

entities.name: Response to paging or notification via 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where SERVICE REQUEST is sent as response to paging or notification for PDU sessions associated with non-3GPP access.

entities.name: No PDU sessions allowed for re-establishment
entities.description: Condition where there are no PDU sessions for which UE allows user-plane resources to be re-established over 3GPP access.

entities.name: User-plane resources re-established over 3GPP access
entities.description: Property indicating user-plane resources of PDU sessions associated with non-3GPP access can be re-established over 3GPP access.

relations.description: SERVICE REQUEST message contains the Allowed PDU session status IE under specified conditions.
Inclusion of Allowed PDU session status IE is guarded by the condition of responding to paging/notification for non-3GPP PDU sessions.
Inclusion of Allowed PDU session status IE is guarded by the condition of having no PDU sessions allowed for re-establishment.
Allowed PDU session status IE establishes which PDU sessions have user-plane resources allowed to be re-established over 3GPP access.
